name: index_folder
description: Index a local folder containing source code. Response includes `discovery_skip_counts` (files filtered per reason), `no_symbols_count`/`no_symbols_files` (files with no extractable symbols) for diagnosing missing files. Set JCODEMUNCH_USE_AI_SUMMARIES=false to disable AI summaries globally.

path.description: Path to local folder (absolute or relative, supports ~ for home directory)

use_ai_summaries.description: Use AI to generate symbol summaries. Supports Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, MiniMax, and GLM-5 via env vars. When false, uses docstrings or signature fallback.

extra_ignore_patterns.description: Additional gitignore-style patterns to exclude from indexing (merged with JCODEMUNCH_EXTRA_IGNORE_PATTERNS env var)

follow_symlinks.description: Whether to include symlinked files in indexing. Symlinked directories are never followed (prevents infinite loops from circular symlinks). Default false for security.

incremental.description: When true and an existing index exists, only re-index changed files.
